prompt: Build a Node/Express route handler for POST /orders that validates the request body (needs customerId and items array), saves the order to a database, and returns the created order.

assertions.text: Business logic is separated from HTTP concerns — there is at least a distinct service/handler layer separate from the route
Request body is validated before reaching any business logic, using a schema or explicit checks
Errors are explicitly caught and handled — no unhandled promise rejections or try/catch-less async
Internal error details (stack traces, DB errors) are not exposed in the HTTP response
Returns 201 on success and 400 on validation failure (not just 200 for everything)
